facts.text: Under the UVA Wise Within Reach program, any Virginia student whose family income is $80,000 or less who qualifies for admission will have tuition and fees paid on their behalf.

sources.title: For Virginians - UVA Wise
sources.quote: Any student from Virginia whose family has an income of $80,000 or less who qualifies for admission to UVA Wise will have tuition and fees paid on their behalf.
